camel_example: aliyun wyota ListVersionDistribution --region cn-hangzhou --ClientType 1 --Model 'AS05-2DCXG' --VersionType SYS --version 2021-04-20 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the distribution of endpoint versions
description_zh: 查询终端版本分布情况
kebab_example: aliyun wyota list-version-distribution --version-type SYS --client-type 1 --model AS05-2DCXG --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListVersionDistribution

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the endpoint is managed. Valid values: true: The endpoint is managed. false: The endpoint is not managed. If you do not specify this parameter, all endpoints are queried
parameters.help_zh: 纳管状态。true 表示已纳管，false 表示未纳管；不传表示全部
parameters.name: in_manage

parameters.help_en: The version type. Valid values: SYS: system version. APP: application version
parameters.help_zh: 版本类型。取值：SYS（系统版本）、APP（应用版本）
parameters.name: version_type

parameters.help_en: The endpoint type. Valid values: 1: hardware endpoint. 2: software endpoint. 3: secure browser plug-in. 4: GuestOS application. 5: DingTalk Wuying plug-in. 6: cloud application component. 7: Cloud Hub. 8: H5
parameters.help_zh: 终端类型。取值：1（硬终端）、2（软终端）、3（安全浏览器插件）、4（GuestOS 应用）、5（钉钉无影插件）、6（云应用组件）、7（云 Hub）、8（H5）
parameters.name: client_type

parameters.help_en: The business type. Default value: enterprise
parameters.name: main_biz_type

Code.description_en: The status code. 200 is returned if the call is successful. An error code is returned if the call fails
Code.description_zh: 状态码。成功时返回 200，失败时返回错误码

Data.description_en: The list of version distribution information

DeviceCount.description_en: The number of endpoints that run this version
DeviceCount.description_zh: 该版本对应的终端数量

Percentage.description_en: The version percentage. Valid values: 0 to 1

Message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is empty if the call is successful
Message.description_zh: 错误信息。调用成功时为空

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful
